title: Time A to B
description: Essential: Correctly calculates total time (2.25 s) by summing acceleration and constant velocity phases on the belt.

title: Scratch Length
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the scratch length (0.5 m) from relative motion during acceleration on the belt.

title: Block Acceleration on Belt
description: Important: Applies Newton's second law to find block acceleration (4 m/s²) due to kinetic friction on the conveyor.

title: Block Acceleration on Board (F on block)
description: Important: For part (2), correctly finds block's deceleration (3 m/s²) on the board considering applied force and friction.

title: Relative Motion Analysis
description: Important: For parts (2) and (3), uses relative displacement between block and board to find minimum plank length.

title: Board Acceleration (F on board)
description: Important: For part (3), correctly calculates board's acceleration (1 m/s²) with applied force and ground friction.

title: Board Total Displacement
description: Optional: For part (3), correctly computes total board displacement (0.167 m) including sliding and stopping phases.

title: Sign/Direction Error
description: Pitfall: Incorrect sign for friction or acceleration when block and board move relative to each other or ground.

title: Unit Omission
description: Pitfall: Final answers lack proper SI units (s, m) or includes incorrect units.
